articles.title: Jonathan Ross 'horrified' by Walliams allegations and Brand conviction
articles.description: The TV presenter says he was once "friendly" with David Walliams and Russell Brand, but was "genuinely unaware" of their conduct.

articles.title: 'I felt like I was being manipulated': Woman alleges Walliams groomed her as a teenager
articles.description: Lilly Creightmore, who has alleged Walliams "groomed" her as a teenager, has told BBC Newsnight that she was "angry" at his behaviour.

articles.title: Thousands of schools in Italy, Scotland and Northern Ireland hit by threats in suspected bomb hoax
articles.description: More than 6,000 Italian schools received a threat. Authorities in all three countries say there appears to be no risk to the public. It is not known if the incidents are linked.

articles.title: Scottish DJ, 32, confirmed as victim of Krakow shooting
articles.description: The man, who is understood to be James Thomas Campbell from Prestwick, died when a lone gunman opened fire in central Krakow on Saturday.
